answer: Cap sybil growth with scarce, expiring sponsorships. An established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers each epoch and stays liable on a locked stake. Reviewers then examine the newcomer through a prism of independent checks: unique counterparties, elapsed waits, and funding provenance. If a nebula of freshly sponsored keys collapses onto one wallet cluster, a falcon audit fuses them into a single seat and slashes the sponsor, so mass cloning cannot cheaply outvote honest agents.
